h1: Areas We Cover | Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction

intro.html: At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we’re proud to deliver high-quality carpentry services and construction solutions to homeowners across Cambridgeshire and Suffolk. Based in Red Lodge, we work locally to provide expert support with everything from house extensions, single storey extensions, double storey extensions, wrap around extensions, extension builder, timber framed extensions and garage conversions to kitchen fitting, media walls and bespoke carpentry.

We know how important it is to find a trusted local carpenter who understands your area. That’s why we focus on serving communities close to home, ensuring a reliable, personal service for every project.

chapters.heading: Expert Carpentry & Construction in Your Area

blocks.html: With over 40 years of combined experience, we bring expert craftsmanship and a personal touch to homes across the region. Whether you’re looking to expand with an extension, transform an unused garage, or upgrade your kitchen, our family-run team is here to help.
